messages:
maya: Heads-up — eviction rate for kv shard=17 in us-east-1 jumped from ~0.3% to ~4.7% between 08:14 and 08:20 UTC. Alert fired and bumped to P2. Seen on chat-heavy routes only. Link: https://grafana.internal/r/kv-ops

omar: saw the alert. any recent rollouts or config changes?

jun: I rolled out a kernel selection tweak last night (PR #4521) that shifts some attention kernels to the new fused path. It shouldn't change cache semantics, but it does change allocation patterns.

deploy-bot: Deployment 'runtime-kernel-opt' rolled out to us-east-1 at 2025-06-18T08:02:12Z by jun.

sasha: can we get quick numbers for residency, eviction_count, and hit_rate per shard? want to add a panel that slices by route/model.

maya: attaching quick promQL I ran:
```
sum by (shard) (increase(kv_evictions_total{env="prod",region="us-east-1"}[6m]))
/
sum by (shard) (increase(kv_inserts_total{env="prod",region="us-east-1"}[6m]))
```
result: shard=17 -> 0.047, others ~0.003-0.005. Also: kv_residency_bytes{shard="17"} climbed steadily with long-context traffic.

lucy: I grabbed a couple pprof snapshots from the runtime host (host=kv-primary-17). minimal text heap output:
```
pprof: top 10 by allocated space
  45MB  45MB  runtime.mcache  allocation
  32MB  32MB  github.com/redwood/kvcache/fragpool
  18MB  18MB  github.com/redwood/kvcache/prefetch
```
Looks like fragpool + prefetch buffers grew during the spike.

omar: interesting — jun, could kernel fused path be causing larger per-frag metadata or different alignment that increases fragmentation?

jun: possible. The fused kernels use a different internal buffer stride to improve SIMD alignment; that could increase per-frag footprint when sequence lengths are high. I can repro locally with a synthetic long-context run:
```
./run_local_test.sh --model redwood-v1 --seq 6000 --batch 8 --prefetch=1.0
# observe kv_residency_bytes jump and evictions when batch > 4
```
I added a test that toggles the kernel path and saw ~15% higher residency under fused path.

sasha: interim mitigation: add a temporary throttle on prefetch window (config: prefetch.max_ratio=0.5) and add dashboard panels for per-route eviction_rate, residency_bytes, avg_fragment_size. I'll push the dash and alert (eviction_rate > 1% for 5m) :mag:

infra-bot: mitigation applied: prefetch.max_ratio=0.5 rolled out to us-east-1 at 2025-06-18T08:42:03Z by sasha.

maya: good. assigning eng-runtime oncall to monitor. If eviction_rate doesn't fall below 1% in 10m we will rollback PR #4521. Also capture KV cache traces (kv:sample=1%) and heap dumps.

lucy: uploaded pprof+heap snapshots to gs://redwood-ops/kv-incident/kv-1890123456.tar.gz and added links to incident doc.

omar: followup action items:
- jun: add microbench that measures per-fragment footprint for both kernel paths (ACTION).
- sasha: add per-route residency dashboards + 5m eviction alert (ACTION).
- lucy: collect 1h of sampler traces + pprof for shard 17 and attach (ACTION).
- maya: coordinate possible rollback if mitigation doesn't help (ACTION).

jun: I'll start the microbench now and post numbers in this thread. early hunch: limit prefetch or align allocations to smaller stride for long contexts as a long-term fix.

maya: thanks team — monitoring now. will update in 10m.
